title: Configuration decoded from cells
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input symbols, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $s$ be a natural number, let $f$ assign a cell value to each natural index, and let $pos$ be one of the $|x|+2$ input-head positions. The decoded configuration has internal state and output summary read from cell $f(0)$, and input-head position $pos$. On each work tape, cells with integer index $z$ satisfying $|z|\le s$ receive the optional symbol stored at index $z+s$ of $f$; all other cells are blank. Each work-tape head is placed at the least index $j$ with $0\le j<2s+1$ whose corresponding flag is true, shifted by $-s$, or at $0$ if there is no such index.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols
$f$ assigns a cell value at every natural index
$pos$ is an input-head position among $|x|+2$ positions
